validation.packageBinding: Each sample is bound through its cohort/probe manifest role to a verified ASAR; raw samples do not embed their own ASAR hash.
validation.budgetOutcome: Functional completeness and provenance are generation prerequisites; over-budget observations remain in the report and never become passing values.

warnings.warning: Endpoint observation only: this does not establish whether focus changed during any timed action. The existing timing helper requires visible/non-minimized, not focused.

environment.inspectionScope: These two blank-app inspections document observed feature states around ending the Sky client. They do not retrospectively identify the AX state of every A sample.

summary.note: Automation wall clock, full-window frame gaps, pre-input gaps and actual-input interaction gaps are retained separately. The 100 ms normal-interaction budget uses only time at/after actual input, including a spanning frame remainder; actions without input use measurement start. Legacy samples keep full-window gating. This report does not cover pending cancellation, GC cycles, functional regressions or package acceptance.

canvas.coldDefinition: New application process and user-data directory, first document open; OS file cache is not flushed.
canvas.repeatDefinition: Reopen the same file in the same process; all semantic DOM and 500 attached highlights required.
canvas.frameWindowDefinition: Original full automation window retained; separate normal-interaction window begins at first actual input (spanning intervals clipped at input), or measurement start for actions without input.

loaded.coldDefinition: New application process and user-data directory, first document open; OS file cache is not flushed.
loaded.frameWindowDefinition: Original full automation window retained; separate normal-interaction window begins at first actual input (spanning intervals clipped at input), or measurement start for actions without input.

B.environmentDescriptor: Forty timing observations collected after ending the Sky UIA client; every sample independently records nativeAPIs-only at start/end. No product AX feature was forced off.

memory.interpretation: Forced-GC renderer heap and sums across all observed app processes are separate measurements. Totals retain one decimal MiB; process identifiers are omitted. Three cycles do not prove absence of a leak.

runs.label: pending-5m-5
runs.failure: The next canvas drag could not hit the intended visible card.
runs.scope: Partial logged wall-clock measurements are retained observations, not a complete probe result or a recovered input-to-ready/frame measurement.

retainedProbeAttempts.note: This original attempt is retained separately. Its partial/failing run is never relabeled as a completed passing probe or substituted into the selected complete probe set.

limits: No timing samples or failure values were removed. A and B are distinct recorded conditions, not replacement attempts.
B requires detected nativeAPIs-only before/after snapshots. No product or system accessibility feature is disabled by this collector.
Window focus is retained as an endpoint observation with warnings for false. It is not an added timing prerequisite and does not prove focus state throughout the timed actions.
The observations do not establish an accessibility-enabled performance pass, cross-display physical DPI acceptance, clean-machine acceptance or absence of memory leaks.
